words.en: A preference is a greater liking for one alternative over another or others.

words.tr: n. 爆炸；（感情）爆发；激增；
words.ex: The explosion broke all the windows.
words.ex_cn: 爆炸震碎了所有的窗户。
words.en: An explosion is a sudden, violent burst of energy, for example one caused by a bomb.

words.ex: The theatrical lighting made the stage look magical.
words.ex_cn: 剧场的灯光让舞台显得神奇。
words.en: Theatrical means relating to the theatre or to the performance of plays. It can also describe behaviour that is exaggerated and intended to attract attention.

words.ex: Farmers cultivate rice in the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植水稻。
words.en: To cultivate land means to prepare it and grow crops on it. To cultivate a particular quality, skill, or attitude means to try hard to develop it and make it stronger.

words.ex: He is a collector of old coins.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位古钱币收藏家。
words.en: A collector is a person who collects things of a particular type as a hobby or for investment.

words.ex: He felt miserable after losing his job.
words.ex_cn: 他失业后感到很悲惨。
words.en: If you are miserable, you are very unhappy.

words.ex: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他打篮球时伤了手腕。
words.en: The part of your body where your hand joins your arm.

words.ex: The rabbit jumps over the small fence.
words.ex_cn: 兔子跳过了小篱笆。
words.en: A rabbit is a small furry animal with long ears. Rabbits are sometimes kept as pets.

words.ex: He accustoms himself to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他让自己习惯早起。
words.en: If you accustom yourself or someone else to something, you make yourself or them familiar with it or used to it.

words.ex: The tide comes in every twelve hours.
words.ex_cn: 潮汐每十二小时涨一次。
words.en: The tide is the regular change in the level of the sea on the shore.

words.tr:
v. 侮辱；辱骂
n. 侮辱；辱骂
words.ex: He insulted her with rude words.
words.ex_cn: 他用粗鲁的话侮辱了她。
words.en: To insult someone means to say or do something that is rude or offensive.

words.ex: He gave a thumbs-up with his thumb.
words.ex_cn: 他用大拇指比了个赞。
words.en: The thick short digit on the hand that is opposite to the fingers and can be moved to be opposite any of the other fingers.

words.ex: He ate a lump of sugar.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了一块糖。
words.en: A lump is a solid piece of something, often with no particular shape. If you lump things together, you put them together in a group or treat them as the same.

words.ex: The loud music annoys me.
words.ex_cn: 嘈杂的音乐让我烦恼。
words.en: If someone or something annoys you, it makes you fairly angry and impatient.

words.ex: The child plays with a toy car.
words.ex_cn: 孩子在玩一辆玩具汽车。
words.en: A toy is an object for children to play with.

words.ex: The wound will heal in a few days.
words.ex_cn: 伤口几天后就会愈合。
words.en: To make or become healthy or whole again; to cure or recover from an injury or illness.

words.ex: The pond is shallow, so you can see the bottom.
words.ex_cn: 这个池塘很浅，所以你能看到底部。
words.en: If something is shallow, it does not extend far down from the top surface.

words.ex: The repetition of the same words made the lesson boring.
words.ex_cn: 相同词语的重复让这堂课变得无聊。
words.en: The act of repeating something that has already been said or written.

words.ex: He is eating soup for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他正在吃汤当午餐。
words.en: Soup is a liquid food made by boiling meat, fish, or vegetables in water or stock.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

words.ex: The mountain scenery is very beautiful.
words.ex_cn: 山景非常美丽。
words.en: The natural features of a landscape considered in terms of their appearance, especially when picturesque.

words.ex: He eats an apple every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃一个苹果。
words.en: A round fruit with firm, white flesh and a green, red, or yellow skin.

words.ex: His rude words were an offense to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 他粗鲁的话冒犯了所有人。
words.en: An offense is a crime or a violation of the law; it can also refer to a feeling of being upset or annoyed by something perceived as insulting or disrespectful.

words.ex: The bottle has a cork stopper.
words.ex_cn: 这个瓶子有一个软木塞。
words.en: Cork is a light, porous material obtained from the bark of the cork oak tree, used especially for making stoppers for bottles.

words.ex: The apple is ripe and ready to eat.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果熟了，可以吃了。
words.en: When fruit or crops are ripe, they are ready to be eaten or harvested because they have developed to the right stage.

words.tr:
n. 暴躁脾气；情绪；心情；性情
v. 使…缓和；冲淡
words.ex: He loses his temper when he is tired.
words.ex_cn: 当他累了的时候，他会发脾气。
words.en: If you refer to someone's temper or say that they have a temper, you mean that they become angry very easily.

words.ex: My throat is sore after singing.
words.ex_cn: 我唱歌后喉咙疼。
words.en: If part of your body is sore, it causes you pain and discomfort.

words.ex: He gave her a light pinch on the arm.
words.ex_cn: 他轻轻捏了她的胳膊一下。
words.en: To pinch someone or something means to squeeze them tightly between your thumb and finger, or between two surfaces, especially in a way that causes pain.

words.ex: She wore a diamond ring on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一枚钻石戒指。
words.en: A diamond is a precious stone consisting of a clear and colorless crystalline form of pure carbon, the hardest naturally occurring substance.

words.ex: He uses a razor to shave every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上用剃须刀刮胡子。
words.en: A razor is a tool with a sharp blade or set of blades, used to remove hair from the face or body.

words.ex: The child gave an imaginative story about flying cats.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子讲了一个关于会飞的猫的富有想象力的故事。
words.en: If you describe someone or their ideas as imaginative, you are praising them because they are easily able to think of or create new or exciting things.

words.tr:
n. 钩；挂钩；
v. 钩住；
words.ex: The key hung on a metal hook.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙挂在金属钩上。
words.en: A hook is a bent piece of metal or plastic that is used for catching or holding things, or for hanging things on.

words.ex: The wire is made of copper.
words.ex_cn: 这根电线是铜制的。
words.en: Copper is a reddish-brown metal that is used especially for making wire and coins.

words.ex: The landlord fixed the broken window.
words.ex_cn: 房东修好了破掉的窗户。
words.en: A landlord is a person who owns land or property and rents it out to others.

words.ex: He is an influential teacher in our school.
words.ex_cn: 他是我们学校一位有影响力的老师。
words.en: Having great influence on someone or something.

words.ex: The apple will rot if left in the sun.
words.ex_cn: 如果把苹果放在太阳下，它会腐烂。
words.en: If something rots, or if it is left to rot, it decays and falls apart because of natural processes. Rot can also refer to a state of decay or decomposition.

words.ex: The tree has a hollow trunk.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树的树干是中空的。
words.en: If something is hollow, it has an empty space inside it.

words.ex: They enclose the garden with a wooden fence.
words.ex_cn: 他们用木栅栏把花园围起来。
words.en: If you enclose something with a letter, you put it in the same envelope as the letter.

words.ex: The hardship helped him harden his spirit.
words.ex_cn: 困难使他的精神变得坚强。
words.en: To make or become hard or harder; to make or become more severe, strict, or unfeeling.

words.ex: The wicked witch cast a spell on the prince.
words.ex_cn: 邪恶的女巫对王子施了咒语。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as wicked, you mean that they are very bad, immoral, or cruel.

words.ex: The wind stiffened the cloth on the line.
words.ex_cn: 风把晾衣绳上的布吹硬了。
words.en: to make or become stiff or rigid; to make or become more severe or strict

words.ex: She wears a silk dress to the party.
words.ex_cn: 她穿了一件丝绸连衣裙去参加派对。
words.en: A fine, strong, soft, lustrous fiber produced by silkworms in making cocoons and collected to make thread and fabric.

words.tr:
adj. 竖直的；直立的；
adv. 笔直地；
words.ex: The picture is hanging upright on the wall.
words.ex_cn: 这幅画垂直地挂在墙上。
words.en: If you are sitting or standing upright, you are sitting or standing with your back straight, rather than bending or lying down.

words.ex: He is selfish and never shares his toys.
words.ex_cn: 他很自私，从不分享他的玩具。
words.en: If you say that someone is selfish, you mean that they only care about their own interests and do not consider the needs or feelings of other people.

words.ex: The tiger has black stripes on its orange fur.
words.ex_cn: 老虎的橙色皮毛上有黑色条纹。
words.en: A stripe is a long, narrow band or strip differing in color or texture from the surface on either side of it.

words.ex: The pig is eating food in the yard.
words.ex_cn: 猪正在院子里吃东西。
words.en: A pig is a farm animal with short legs, a fat body, and a curved tail. Pigs are kept for their meat, which is called pork.

words.ex: The ship sailed inward toward the harbor.
words.ex_cn: 船向港口内航行。
words.en: Directed or moving towards the inside; relating to the inside or inner part of something.

words.ex: He showed excellence in math competitions.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学竞赛中表现出色。
words.en: The quality of being outstanding or extremely good.

words.tr:
n. 耙子；耙地机
v. 用耙子耙；扫掠过；搜索
words.ex: He uses a rake to collect leaves.
words.ex_cn: 他用耙子收集树叶。
words.en: A rake is a garden tool consisting of a row of metal or wooden teeth attached to a long handle. You use a rake to make the earth level or to gather leaves together.

words.tr:
adj. 紫色的；
n. 紫色；
words.ex: The flower is purple.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花是紫色的。
words.en: Purple is a color that is a mixture of red and blue.

words.ex: He hastened to finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他赶紧在晚饭前写完作业。
words.en: If you hasten to do something, you quickly do it or quickly go somewhere.

words.ex: We need to shorten the meeting to one hour.
words.ex_cn: 我们需要把会议缩短到一小时。
words.en: To make something shorter in length, duration, or extent.

words.ex: The audience gave applause after the song.
words.ex_cn: 歌曲结束后，观众鼓掌了。
words.en: Applause is the noise made by a group of people clapping their hands to show approval or enjoyment.

words.tr:
n. 疼痛；隐痛；渴望
v. 疼痛；隐痛
words.ex: My head aches after staying up late.
words.ex_cn: 我熬夜后头痛。
words.en: If you ache or a part of your body aches, you feel a steady, fairly strong pain.

words.ex: He gave her a sincere apology.
words.ex_cn: 他向她真诚地道歉了。
words.en: An apology is something that you say or write in order to tell someone that you are sorry that you have hurt them or caused trouble for them.

words.ex: He tied a knot in the rope.
words.ex_cn: 他在绳子上打了一个结。
words.en: A knot is a fastening made by tying a piece of string, rope, or something similar. It can also refer to a hard mass formed in a tree trunk at the intersection with a branch, or a unit of speed equal to one nautical mile per hour, used especially by ships and aircraft.

words.ex: My brother's son is my nephew.
words.ex_cn: 我弟弟的儿子是我的侄子。
words.en: A nephew is a son of one's sibling or sibling-in-law.

words.ex: She put a cushion on the chair to make it comfortable.
words.ex_cn: 她在椅子上放了一个靠垫，让它更舒服。
words.en: A cushion is a soft bag of some ornamental material, stuffed with wool, hair, feathers, polyester staple fiber, non-woven material, or even paper torn into fragments. It may be used for sitting or kneeling upon, or to soften the hardness or angularity of a chair or couch.

words.ex: The heavy rain drowned the small village.
words.ex_cn: 大雨淹没了这个小村庄。
words.en: To die by being underwater too long and unable to breathe, or to kill someone in this way.

words.ex: The children play at Nursery 796.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在796号托儿所玩耍。
words.en: A nursery is a place where young children are cared for during the day while their parents are at work.

words.ex: He drank a pint of beer after work.
words.ex_cn: 他下班后喝了一品脱啤酒。
words.en: A pint is a unit of measurement for liquids. In Britain, it is equal to 568 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon. In the United States, it is equal to 473 cubic centimeters or one eighth of a gallon.

words.ex: The fierce lion chased the deer.
words.ex_cn: 那只凶猛的狮子追赶着鹿。
words.en: A fierce animal or person is very aggressive or angry.

words.ex: The child imitates her mother's voice.
words.ex_cn: 孩子模仿她妈妈的声音。
words.en: If you imitate someone, you copy what they do or produce.

words.ex: He read the story aloud to his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他大声给小妹妹读这个故事。
words.en: If you say something aloud, you say it in a normal speaking voice, rather than whispering or thinking it.

words.ex: The children's laughter brought gaiety to the party.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们的笑声为派对带来了欢乐。
words.en: Gaiety is a feeling, attitude, or atmosphere of liveliness and fun.

words.ex: The robbery happened at the bank yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 昨天银行发生了抢劫。
words.en: The crime of stealing from someone or somewhere, especially using violence or threats.

words.ex: He tightened the screw with a wrench.
words.ex_cn: 他用扳手把螺丝拧紧。
words.en: If you tighten a rule, policy, or system, you make it stricter or more efficient.

words.ex: She seeks perfection in everything she does.
words.ex_cn: 她在所做的每件事中都追求完美。
words.en: The state of being perfect; the highest degree of excellence or quality.

words.tr:
n. 蔑视
v. 蔑视
words.ex: He looked at the lie with scorn.
words.ex_cn: 他轻蔑地看着这个谎言。
words.en: If you scorn someone or something, you feel or show contempt for them.

words.ex: Whoever wants to join can sign up.
words.ex_cn: 任何想加入的人都可以报名。
words.en: used to refer to any person or people, when it does not matter who

words.tr: n. 树干；大衣箱；象鼻子；
words.ex: The elephant held the branch with its trunk.
words.ex_cn: 大象用它的鼻子抓住树枝。
words.en: The main stem of a tree, below the branches, and above the ground; the main part of the body, excluding the head, arms, and legs; the long, flexible nose of an elephant; a large, strong box used for transporting or storing clothes and other personal possessions.

words.ex: She knits a sweater from wool.
words.ex_cn: 她用羊毛织毛衣。
words.en: Wool is the hair that grows on sheep and some other animals, which is used to make clothes, blankets, etc.

words.ex: The sailor fixed the rope on the boat.
words.ex_cn: 水手修理了船上的绳子。
words.en: A sailor is a person who works on a ship as a member of its crew.

words.ex: He beat his competitor in the race.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中击败了对手。
words.en: A competitor is a person, team, or company that is competing against others, especially in business or sports.

words.tr:
n. 月光
v. 兼职；（尤在夜间）从事第二职业
words.ex: She works as a waitress at night to moonlight.
words.ex_cn: 她晚上当服务员来兼职。
words.en: The light that comes from the moon at night.

words.ex: A deer is walking in the forest.
words.ex_cn: 一只鹿正在森林里走路。
words.en: A deer is a large wild animal that eats grass and leaves. The male has antlers that are shed and regrown each year.

words.ex: He ate a bowl of beans for lunch.
words.ex_cn: 他午餐吃了一碗豆子。
words.en: A bean is a seed from one of several genera of the flowering plant family Fabaceae, which are used for human or animal food.

words.ex: She wears everyday clothes to work.
words.ex_cn: 她穿日常的衣服去上班。
words.en: Something that is everyday is ordinary and common, not special or unusual.

words.ex: He pulled the keys from the drawer.
words.ex_cn: 他从抽屉里拿出钥匙。
words.en: A drawer is a sliding container that fits into a piece of furniture, such as a desk or chest, and is used for storing things.

words.tr:
n. 漠视；忽视；
v. 漠视；不理会；不顾；
words.ex: His advice was met with disregard.
words.ex_cn: 他的建议遭到了漠视。
words.en: If you disregard something, you ignore it or do not take account of it.

words.ex: Nowadays, many children use tablets to learn.
words.ex_cn: 现在，许多孩子用平板电脑学习。
words.en: At the present time, in contrast with the past.

words.ex: He waved a patriotic flag during the parade.
words.ex_cn: 他在游行中挥舞着一面爱国的旗帜。
words.en: If someone is patriotic, they feel love, loyalty, and respect for their country.

words.ex: The can is made of tin.
words.ex_cn: 这个罐子是锡做的。
words.en: Tin is a soft, silvery-white metal that is often used to coat other metals to prevent them from rusting. It is also used in the production of tin cans and other containers.

words.ex: He found a penny on the ground.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上发现了一便士。
words.en: A penny is a small unit of currency used in the United Kingdom and the United States. In the UK, it is the smallest denomination of the pound sterling, and in the US, it is a cent, the smallest denomination of the dollar.

words.ex: The bird lives in a small cage.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟住在一个小笼子里。
words.en: A cage is a structure of wire or metal bars in which birds or animals are kept.

words.tr:
v. 原谅；宽恕；请再说一遍
n. 原谅；宽恕
words.ex: Can you pardon me for being late?
words.ex_cn: 你能原谅我迟到吗？
words.en: If you pardon someone, you forgive them for something they have done wrong. If someone is pardoned, they are officially forgiven for a crime they have committed.

words.ex: I haven't seen him lately.
words.ex_cn: 我最近没见到他。
words.en: If you say that something has happened lately, you mean that it has happened recently.

words.ex: He offended the law by stealing.
words.ex_cn: 他偷窃触犯了法律。
words.en: If you offend someone, you upset or embarrass them by saying or doing something that they think is rude or insulting.

words.ex: The sandpaper feels coarse to the touch.
words.ex_cn: 这张砂纸摸起来很粗糙。
words.en: Coarse things have a rough texture because they consist of thick threads or large pieces.

words.ex: Parents often spoil their children with too many toys.
words.ex_cn: 父母经常用太多玩具宠坏孩子。
words.en: To spoil something means to reduce its quality or value, often by damaging it in some way. It can also mean to treat someone, especially a child, with too much kindness or indulgence, leading to their detriment.

words.ex: The line is horizontal on the graph.
words.ex_cn: 这条线在图上是水平的。
words.en: Parallel to the plane of the horizon; at right angles to the vertical.

words.tr:
n. 刺；刺痛；
v. 刺；刺痛；
words.ex: The bee gave him a sharp sting.
words.ex_cn: 蜜蜂给了他一下刺痛。
words.en: If a plant, animal, or insect stings you, it pricks your skin and usually pushes poison into your body with a sharp pointed part of its body.

words.ex: The farmer dug a ditch to water the fields.
words.ex_cn: 农夫挖了一条沟来给田地浇水。
words.en: A ditch is a long narrow trench or furrow dug in the ground, especially for drainage or irrigation.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.ex: He cooked dinner; meantime, the kids did their homework.
words.ex_cn: 他做晚饭；与此同时，孩子们在做作业。
words.en: The time between one event and another; meanwhile.

words.tr:
n. 咳嗽；
v. 咳嗽；
words.ex: He had a bad cough last night.
words.ex_cn: 他昨晚咳得很厉害。
words.en: A cough is a sudden, forceful expulsion of air from the lungs, often caused by irritation in the airway.

words.ex: He is deaf and uses sign language to communicate.
words.ex_cn: 他是聋的，使用手语交流。
words.en: If someone is deaf, they cannot hear anything, or they cannot hear very well.

words.ex: The knight held a sharp sword in his hand.
words.ex_cn: 骑士手里拿着一把锋利的剑。
words.en: A sword is a weapon with a long metal blade and a hilt with a handguard, used for thrusting or striking and now typically worn as part of ceremonial dress.

words.ex: He sent a message through a messenger.
words.ex_cn: 他通过信使发送了一条消息。
words.en: A messenger is someone who carries messages from one person to another.

words.tr: adj. 徒劳的；空虚的；自负的；爱慕虚荣的
words.ex: It's vain to try to fix what can't be fixed.
words.ex_cn: 试图修复无法修复的东西是徒劳的。
words.en: If you describe someone as vain, you are critical of their extreme pride in their own beauty, intelligence, or other good qualities.

words.ex: The king lives in a big castle.
words.ex_cn: 国王住在一座大城堡里。
words.en: A castle is a large building or group of buildings fortified against attack with thick walls, battlements, towers, and in many cases a moat.

words.ex: The rubber band is elastic.
words.ex_cn: 橡皮筋是有弹性的。
words.en: An elastic material is able to stretch and then return to its original shape or size.

words.tr:
n. 梳子
v. 梳理；搜寻
words.ex: He uses a comb to tidy his hair.
words.ex_cn: 他用梳子整理头发。
words.en: A comb is a flat piece of plastic or metal with narrow pointed teeth along one side, which you use to make your hair neat.

words.ex: He used a long rod to reach the top shelf.
words.ex_cn: 他用一根长杆够到顶层架子。
words.en: A rod is a long, thin, straight bar, especially one made of wood or metal.

words.ex: They widened the road to fit more cars.
words.ex_cn: 他们加宽了这条路，以便容纳更多汽车。
words.en: To make or become wider.

words.ex: He felt deep sorrow when his dog died.
words.ex_cn: 当他的狗去世时，他感到深深的悲痛。
words.en: Sorrow is a feeling of deep sadness or regret.

words.tr: n. 发明家；发明者；创造者；
words.ex: Thomas Edison was a famous inventor.
words.ex_cn: 托马斯·爱迪生是一位著名的发明家。
words.en: An inventor is a person who has invented something, or whose job is to invent things.

words.ex: The hiker stood at the edge of the cliff.
words.ex_cn: 徒步者站在悬崖边上。
words.en: A cliff is a high area of rock with a very steep side, often at the edge of the sea or a river.

words.ex: He opened his umbrella when it started to rain.
words.ex_cn: 天下雨时，他打开了伞。
words.en: An umbrella is a device consisting of a circular canopy of fabric on a folding metal frame, used as protection against rain or sunlight.

words.ex: The phone call caused an interruption in the meeting.
words.ex_cn: 电话打断了会议。
words.en: An interruption is something that temporarily stops an activity or a situation.

words.ex: The children are merry on Christmas day.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们在圣诞节那天很开心。
words.en: If you describe someone's character or behavior as merry, you mean that they are happy and cheerful.

words.ex: He bought a gallon of milk from the store.
words.ex_cn: 他从商店买了一加仑牛奶。
words.en: A gallon is a unit of measurement for liquids that is equal to eight pints. In Britain, it is equal to about 4.546 litres. In America, it is equal to about 3.785 litres.

words.ex: The conquest of the mountain took three days.
words.ex_cn: 攻克这座山花了三天时间。
words.en: The act of conquering a place or people.

words.tr: n. 头痛；令人头痛的人（或事物）；
words.ex: He got a headache after working too long.
words.ex_cn: 他工作太长时间后得了头痛。
words.en: A headache is a pain in your head. If you say that something is a headache, you mean that it causes you difficulty or worry.

words.ex: The tailor made a new suit for the man.
words.ex_cn: 裁缝为这位男士做了一套新西装。
words.en: A tailor is a person whose job is to make men's clothes, especially suits, jackets, and trousers, that fit individual customers. As a verb, to tailor means to make or adapt something for a particular purpose or person.

words.ex: He filled the bucket with water from the well.
words.ex_cn: 他从井里打了一桶水。
words.en: A bucket is a round container with a handle, used for carrying liquids or other substances.

words.tr: n. 香味；香水；气息；察觉；
words.ex: The flower has a sweet scent.
words.ex_cn: 这朵花有甜美的香味。
words.en: A scent is a pleasant smell, especially one that is characteristic of a particular thing. It can also refer to the ability to detect smells or a clue or indication of something.

words.ex: He signed his name with a clear signature.
words.ex_cn: 他用清晰的签名签了名字。
words.en: A signature is a person's name written in a distinctive way as a form of identification in authorizing a document or letter.

words.ex: The farmer drove his cart full of apples to the market.
words.ex_cn: 农夫驾着装满苹果的运货马车去市场。
words.en: A cart is a vehicle with two or four wheels that is pulled by a horse or a person and is used for carrying goods.

words.ex: The sky will darken before the storm.
words.ex_cn: 风暴来临前，天空会变暗。
words.en: To make or become dark or darker.

words.ex: I will call you sometime next week.
words.ex_cn: 我下周某个时候给你打电话。
words.en: At some unspecified or unknown time.

words.ex: The crowd applauded after the performance.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众鼓掌了。
words.en: To applaud means to show approval or praise by clapping the hands.

words.ex: The cat is underneath the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If one thing is underneath another, it is directly under it, often so that it is hidden by it.

words.tr:
int. 喂；哈喽；
n. “喂”的招呼声或问候声；
words.ex: Hello, can you hear me?
words.ex_cn: 喂，你能听到我吗？
words.en: used as a greeting or to begin a telephone conversation

words.tr: n. 伪装；假象；虚伪的表现
words.ex: He was accused of using pretense to gain sympathy.
words.ex_cn: 他被指控利用伪装来博取同情。
words.en: A pretense is an action or way of behaving that is intended to make people believe something that is not true.

words.ex: The plane began its descent at 10,000 feet.
words.ex_cn: 飞机在一万英尺高度开始下降。
words.en: The act of moving or falling downward.

words.ex: The army conquered the small city after a long battle.
words.ex_cn: 军队经过长期战斗征服了这座小城。
words.en: To conquer means to take control of a country or city and its people by force, or to successfully deal with or control something.

words.ex: The framework of the house is made of wood.
words.ex_cn: 房子的骨架是木制的。
words.en: A framework is a particular set of rules, ideas, or beliefs which you use in order to deal with problems or to decide what to do.

words.ex: The document is confidential and cannot be shared.
words.ex_cn: 这份文件是机密的，不能分享。
words.en: If you talk to someone in a confidential way, you talk to them quietly because what you are saying is secret or private.

words.ex: The company made the adoption of new technology quickly.
words.ex_cn: 公司迅速采用了新技术。
words.en: The act of legally taking another's child and bringing it up as one's own, or the act of accepting something new.

words.ex: He felt disgust when he saw the dirty food.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到脏兮兮的食物时，他感到厌恶。
words.en: A feeling of revulsion or profound disapproval aroused by something unpleasant or offensive.

words.ex: He measured his waist with a tape.
words.ex_cn: 他用卷尺测量了自己的腰围。
words.en: Your waist is the middle part of your body where it narrows slightly above your hips.

words.tr: adj. 短暂的；瞬间的；刹那间的
words.ex: The light made a momentary flash.
words.ex_cn: 灯光闪了一下，但只持续了一瞬间。
words.en: lasting for a very short time

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.ex: She wore a white pearl necklace.
words.ex_cn: 她戴着一条白色的珍珠项链。
words.en: A pearl is a hard, rounded object formed within the shell of a pearl oyster or similar mollusk, highly prized as a gemstone.

words.ex: The sun's ray came through the window.
words.ex_cn: 阳光透过窗户照进来。
words.en: A ray of light or heat is a narrow beam of it.

words.ex: He is lazy and doesn't like to do homework.
words.ex_cn: 他很懒，不喜欢做作业。
words.en: If someone is lazy, they are not willing to work or use any effort to do something.

words.ex: The child hurt his limb while playing.
words.ex_cn: 孩子玩耍时伤到了肢体。
words.en: A limb is one of the jointed appendages of an animal used for locomotion or grasping: arm; leg; wing; flipper.

words.ex: The sentence has a grammatical error.
words.ex_cn: 这个句子有一个语法错误。
words.en: Relating to grammar or the rules of grammar.

words.ex: The beast ran fast through the forest.
words.ex_cn: 那只野兽在森林里快速奔跑。
words.en: A beast is a large and dangerous animal.

words.ex: The monkey is eating a banana.
words.ex_cn: 猴子正在吃一根香蕉。
words.en: A monkey is a small to medium-sized primate that typically has a long tail, most kinds of which live in trees in tropical countries.

words.ex: She wore a beautiful jewel on her finger.
words.ex_cn: 她手指上戴着一颗漂亮的珠宝。
words.en: A jewel is a precious stone that is used to decorate valuable objects such as rings or necklaces.

words.ex: His persuasion helped me change my mind.
words.ex_cn: 他的说服让我改变了主意。
words.en: Persuasion is the act of persuading someone to do something or to believe that something is true.

words.ex: The child showed obedience to his parents.
words.ex_cn: 孩子对父母表现出顺从。
words.en: Obedience is the act of following orders or instructions from someone in authority.

words.tr:
n. 短袜；重击
v. 猛打
words.ex: He put on his socks before leaving for school.
words.ex_cn: 他上学前穿上了短袜。
words.en: A sock is a piece of clothing which covers your foot and lower part of your leg, usually made of cotton or wool.

words.ex: The letter 'a' is a vowel.
words.ex_cn: 字母 'a' 是一个元音。
words.en: A vowel is a speech sound which is produced by comparatively open configuration of the vocal tract, with vibration of the vocal cords but without audible friction, and which is a unit of the sound system of a language that forms the nucleus of a syllable.

words.tr:
n. 锤子；
v. 锤打；
words.ex: He hit the nail with a hammer.
words.ex_cn: 他用锤子敲钉子。
words.en: A hammer is a tool that consists of a heavy piece of metal at the end of a handle, used for hitting things.

words.ex: We stayed at a small inn near the mountains.
words.ex_cn: 我们住在山附近的一家小客栈里。
words.en: A small hotel, usually in the countryside, where you can stay the night and have meals.

words.ex: The smoke came out of the chimney.
words.ex_cn: 烟从烟囱里冒出来。
words.en: A chimney is a pipe through which smoke goes up into the air, usually through the roof of a building.

words.tr: n. 不满；令人不满的事物；
words.ex: He showed dissatisfaction with the new rules.
words.ex_cn: 他对新规定表示不满。
words.en: Dissatisfaction is a feeling of not being satisfied or pleased with something.

words.ex: The loud noise was an annoyance to everyone.
words.ex_cn: 那阵噪音让每个人都感到烦恼。
words.en: Annoyance is the feeling of being slightly angry or impatient.

words.ex: The tree has many colorful ornaments.
words.ex_cn: 这棵树上有许多彩色的装饰品。
words.en: An ornament is an object that is used to make something look more attractive but is usually considered to have no practical purpose.

words.ex: Honesty is important in friendship.
words.ex_cn: 诚实在友谊中很重要。
words.en: The quality of being honest, which involves being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit or fraud.

words.ex: The outward force pushed the door open.
words.ex_cn: 向外的力把门推开了。
words.en: An outward movement or position is one that is directed towards the outside or away from the centre.

words.ex: Practice can sharpen your skills.
words.ex_cn: 练习可以提高你的技能。
words.en: To make or become sharp or sharper.

words.ex: He pulled out a handkerchief to wipe his sweat.
words.ex_cn: 他掏出一块手帕擦汗。
words.en: A handkerchief is a small square piece of fabric which you use for blowing your nose.

words.ex: His greed made him steal money from his friends.
words.ex_cn: 他的贪婪让他偷了朋友的钱。
words.en: Greed is the desire to have more of something, such as food or money, than is necessary or fair.

words.ex: The sky looks heavenly at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 日落时天空看起来像天上的。
words.en: If you describe something as heavenly, you mean that it is extremely pleasant or enjoyable.

words.ex: He felt a strong thirst after running.
words.ex_cn: 跑步后他感到强烈的口渴。
words.en: A strong desire to drink something, especially water.

words.ex: My sister's daughter is my niece.
words.ex_cn: 我妹妹的女儿是我的侄女。
words.en: Someone's niece is the daughter of their sister or brother.

words.tr:
v. 溢出；溅出
n. 溢出；溅出
words.ex: He spilled milk on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把牛奶洒在了地上。
words.en: To cause or allow (a liquid, powder, etc.) to flow or fall out of a container, usually by accident.

words.tr:
n. 一条（面包）
v. 游荡；虚度光阴
words.ex: He bought a loaf of bread from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一条面包。
words.en: A loaf is a quantity of bread that is shaped and baked in one piece and usually sliced before being eaten. As a verb, to loaf means to spend time in a lazy way, doing nothing in particular.

words.ex: Farmers grow wheat in the field.
words.ex_cn: 农民在田里种植小麦。
words.en: Wheat is a cereal plant that is grown in temperate countries and is the most important kind grown for food.

words.ex: The bird ate a worm.
words.ex_cn: 鸟吃了一条蚯蚓。
words.en: A worm is a small, long, thin creature with no bones or legs that lives in soil.

words.ex: The government kept the mission in secrecy.
words.ex_cn: 政府将这次任务保密。
words.en: Secrecy is the practice of keeping something secret, or the state of being secret.

words.ex: He was rude to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员很无礼。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.ex: The music heightens the feeling of sadness.
words.ex_cn: 音乐加深了悲伤的感觉。
words.en: If something heightens a feeling or if the feeling heightens, the feeling increases in degree or intensity.

words.ex: He used a roller to flatten the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他用滚筒把泥土压平。
words.en: To flatten something means to make it flat or flatter, or to knock it down to the ground.

words.ex: He tried to loosen the tight screw.
words.ex_cn: 他试图拧松那颗紧的螺丝。
words.en: If you loosen something or if it loosens, it becomes less tight, less firmly fixed, or less strongly attached.

words.ex: He eats cheese every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上吃奶酪。
words.en: Cheese is a food made from the pressed curds of milk, often with added flavorings and sometimes with a hard or soft texture.

words.ex: The rivalry between the two teams is very strong.
words.ex_cn: 这两支队伍之间的竞争非常激烈。
words.en: Competition for the same objective or for superiority in the same field.

words.ex: The royalty lived in a large palace.
words.ex_cn: 皇族住在一座大宫殿里。
words.en: Royalty refers to people of royal blood or status, or a sum of money paid to an author, composer, etc., for each copy of a work sold or for each public performance of their work.

words.ex: He felt discontent with his job.
words.ex_cn: 他对自己的工作感到不满。
words.en: Discontent is a feeling of being unhappy because you are not satisfied with your situation or with what you have.

words.ex: The injury led to a complication in his recovery.
words.ex_cn: 这次受伤使他的康复过程复杂化了。
words.en: A complication is a problem or difficulty that makes a situation harder to deal with.

words.ex: The loud noise gave her a sudden fright.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让她吓了一跳。
words.en: A sudden intense feeling of fear.

words.ex: We played chess indoors because it was raining.
words.ex_cn: 因为下雨，我们在室内下棋。
words.en: Located, done, or used inside a building.

words.ex: She adds flour to make bread.
words.ex_cn: 她加面粉来做面包。
words.en: Flour is a powder made by grinding raw grains, roots, beans, nuts, or seeds. It is used to make many different foods.

words.ex: The actress sings in the movie.
words.ex_cn: 这位女演员在电影中唱歌。
words.en: An actress is a woman whose profession is acting on the stage, in films, or on television.

words.ex: He sent her a card with congratulations.
words.ex_cn: 他给她寄了一张写有祝贺的卡片。
words.en: an expression of pleasure at someone's success or good fortune

words.ex: He added an ounce of salt to the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他往汤里加了一点盐。
words.en: An ounce is a unit of weight used in Britain and the USA. There are sixteen ounces in a pound.

words.ex: He fries fish in a pan every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日用平底锅油炸鱼。
words.en: To cook something in hot fat or oil, or to be cooked in this way.

words.tr: adj. 永久的；永恒的；经久不变的
words.ex: The love between them is everlasting.
words.ex_cn: 他们之间的爱是永恒的。
words.en: Something that is everlasting lasts forever or for a very long time.

words.ex: The goat eats grass in the field.
words.ex_cn: 山羊在田野里吃草。
words.en: A goat is a farm animal or a wild animal that is about the size of a sheep. Goats have horns, and some have long hair.

words.ex: He spilled ink on his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他把墨水洒在了衬衫上。
words.en: Ink is the colored liquid used for writing, printing, or drawing.

words.ex: The disappearance of the keys confused everyone.
words.ex_cn: 钥匙的消失让所有人都感到困惑。
words.en: The act of disappearing or the state of having disappeared.

words.ex: The reproduction of rabbits is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 兔子的生殖速度很快。
words.en: The process of producing offspring or new individuals of the same species, or the act of making a copy of something.

words.tr: v. （使）变厚；变稠；使（情节等）复杂
words.ex: The soup will thicken if you cook it longer.
words.ex_cn: 如果你多煮一会儿，汤会变稠。
words.en: To make or become thick or thicker.

words.ex: He showed avoidance of difficult math problems.
words.ex_cn: 他回避困难的数学问题。
words.en: The act of keeping away from or preventing something from happening.

words.ex: He picked up a spoon to eat the soup.
words.ex_cn: 他拿起一把勺子喝汤。
words.en: A spoon is an object used for eating, stirring, and serving food. It has a small shallow bowl on a handle.

words.ex: He fastened the strap around his wrist.
words.ex_cn: 他把带子系在手腕上。
words.en: A strap is a narrow piece of leather, cloth, or other material that is used to fasten, secure, or carry something, or to hold onto something.

words.ex: He deceived his friend with a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他用一个谎言欺骗了朋友。
words.en: If you deceive someone, you make them believe something that is not true, usually in order to get some advantage for yourself.

words.ex: She will lengthen the dress for the party.
words.ex_cn: 她会把裙子改长一点去参加派对。
words.en: To make something longer, or to become longer.

words.tr:
n. 报复；报仇
v. 报复
words.ex: He wanted revenge for his brother's death.
words.ex_cn: 他想为他兄弟的死报仇。
words.en: Revenge involves hurting or punishing someone who has hurt or harmed you.

words.ex: He made a correction to his answer.
words.ex_cn: 他改正了他的答案。
words.en: A correction is a change that makes something right, accurate, or better.

words.ex: He is a descendant of the first king.
words.ex_cn: 他是第一位国王的后裔。
words.en: A person, plant, or animal that is descended from a particular ancestor.

words.ex: He spoke without hesitation.
words.ex_cn: 他毫不犹豫地说了。
words.en: Hesitation is the act of pausing before doing something, especially because you are nervous or not certain about it.

words.ex: He dug a hole with a spade.
words.ex_cn: 他用铁锹挖了一个洞。
words.en: A spade is a tool used for digging, with a sharp-edged, typically rectangular metal blade and a long handle. In card games, a spade is one of the four suits, represented by a black symbol resembling a pointed leaf with a short stem.

words.tr: n. 盆地；流域；水池；脸盆；
words.ex: The river flows into a large basin.
words.ex_cn: 河流流入一个巨大的盆地。
words.en: A basin is a large or small depression in the Earth's surface or a large container that holds water.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.ex: The omission of his name was an accident.
words.ex_cn: 他的名字被漏掉是无意的。
words.en: An omission is something that has not been included or has not been done, either deliberately or accidentally.

words.tr: adj. 老式的；老派的；守旧的
words.ex: He wears an old-fashioned hat.
words.ex_cn: 他戴着一顶过时的帽子。
words.en: If you describe something as old-fashioned, you mean that it is no longer modern, current, or fashionable.

words.ex: He rides his bicycle to school every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天骑自行车去上学。
words.en: A bicycle is a vehicle with two wheels which you ride by sitting on it and pushing two pedals with your feet.

words.ex: The course covers a wide breadth of topics.
words.ex_cn: 这门课程涵盖了广泛的主题。
words.en: The distance or measurement from side to side of something; width.

words.ex: He loves photography and takes pictures every weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他热爱摄影，每个周末都拍照。
words.en: Photography is the art, application, and practice of creating durable images by recording light or other electromagnetic radiation, either electronically by means of an image sensor, or chemically by means of a light-sensitive material such as photographic film.

words.tr:
n. 懦夫；胆小鬼；胆怯者
adj. 胆小的；怯懦的
words.ex: He was a coward and ran away from the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他是个懦夫，逃跑了。
words.en: A coward is someone who is easily frightened and avoids dangerous or difficult situations.

words.ex: He put a mat on the floor to keep it clean.
words.ex_cn: 他在地上放了一块垫子以保持清洁。
words.en: A mat is a piece of thick fabric or other material that is placed on a floor or other surface to protect it or to provide a soft surface to stand or sit on.

words.ex: They rejoice when the sun comes out.
words.ex_cn: 当太阳出来时，他们欢呼。
words.en: To feel or show great joy or delight.

words.ex: He cheated on the test by copying answers.
words.ex_cn: 他通过抄答案来作弊。
words.en: To cheat means to act dishonestly or unfairly in order to gain an advantage, especially in a game or examination.

words.ex: I congratulate you on your success.
words.ex_cn: 我祝贺你取得成功。
words.en: If you congratulate someone, you express pleasure for something good that has happened to them, or you praise them for something they have achieved.

words.ex: The hard chair caused him discomfort.
words.ex_cn: 这把硬椅子让他感到不舒适。
words.en: Discomfort is a feeling of slight pain or physical unease, or a feeling of worry or embarrassment.

words.ex: The cows graze in the enclosure.
words.ex_cn: 奶牛在围场里吃草。
words.en: An enclosure is an area that is surrounded by a barrier or fence, often used to keep animals in or to protect something.

words.tr: adj. 注意的；专心的；留心的；关心的
words.ex: The child is attentive in class.
words.ex_cn: 这个孩子上课很专心。
words.en: If you are attentive, you are paying close attention to what is being said or done.

words.ex: The cat licked its paw.
words.ex_cn: 猫舔它的爪子。
words.en: The foot of an animal that has claws or nails, such as a cat, dog, or bear.

words.tr:
n. 溢出；
v. 泛滥；
words.ex: The rain caused an overflow of the river.
words.ex_cn: 雨水导致河水溢出。
words.en: If a liquid or a river overflows, it flows over the edges of the container or place it is in.

words.tr: v. 使不满意；使不满足；使失望
words.ex: The slow service dissatisfy the customers.
words.ex_cn: 缓慢的服务使顾客不满意。
words.en: If something dissatisfies you, it does not satisfy you or give you pleasure.

words.ex: He learned multiplication in second grade.
words.ex_cn: 他在二年级学习了乘法。
words.en: Multiplication is the process of calculating the total of one number multiplied by another.

words.tr:
pron. 无论哪个；
adj. 无论哪个的；
words.ex: You can pick whichever book you like.
words.ex_cn: 你可以选无论哪本书。
words.en: You use whichever to refer to any one of a group of things or people, when it does not matter which one is chosen or considered.

words.ex: Her room is always tidy.
words.ex_cn: 她的房间总是很整洁。
words.en: If you describe something as tidy, you mean that it is neat and arranged in an orderly way.

words.ex: He tried to bribe the officer with money.
words.ex_cn: 他试图用钱贿赂官员。
words.en: A bribe is a sum of money or something valuable that one person offers or gives to another in order to persuade them to do something, usually something dishonest.

words.ex: He will mend his broken shoe.
words.ex_cn: 他将修补他破掉的鞋子。
words.en: If you mend something that is broken or damaged, you repair it, so that it works properly or so that it looks like new again.

words.ex: She is wearing a black stocking.
words.ex_cn: 她穿着一只黑色长筒袜。
words.en: A stocking is a piece of clothing which fits closely over the foot and is worn up to the knee or higher. Stockings are usually made of nylon or silk and are worn by women.

words.ex: They had a feast on New Year's Day.
words.ex_cn: 他们在元旦举办了一场盛宴。
words.en: A feast is a large and special meal, often to celebrate something.

words.ex: The loud noise every night is a nuisance.
words.ex_cn: 每晚的噪音真是个讨厌的事。
words.en: A nuisance is a person, thing, or situation that is annoying or causes trouble.

words.ex: The rose has a sharp thorn.
words.ex_cn: 玫瑰有一根尖刺。
words.en: A thorn is a sharp, pointed projection on the stem or other part of a plant.

words.ex: The movie was tame and boring.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影枯燥无味。
words.en: If you describe an animal as tame, you mean that it is not afraid of humans and is not dangerous. If you describe a person or their behavior as tame, you mean that they are not very exciting or interesting.

words.tr: adj. 包容的；包含全部费用的；
words.ex: The school is inclusive and welcomes all students.
words.ex_cn: 这所学校是包容的，欢迎所有学生。
words.en: Inclusive is used to describe something that is designed to include all types of people, things, or ideas, and to treat them all fairly and equally.

words.ex: She ate a homemade cake for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐吃了一块家庭自制的蛋糕。
words.en: Something that is homemade has been made in someone's home, rather than in a shop or factory.

words.ex: His handwriting is very neat.
words.ex_cn: 他的笔迹非常工整。
words.en: Handwriting is the style of writing that someone uses when they write with a pen or pencil.

words.ex: The teacher writes on the board with chalk.
words.ex_cn: 老师用粉笔在黑板上写字。
words.en: A soft white limestone (calcium carbonate) formed from the skeletal remains of sea creatures.

words.ex: The lemon tastes sour.
words.ex_cn: 这个柠檬尝起来是酸的。
words.en: Having a sharp, acidic taste; not sweet.

words.ex: The floor is slippery after it rains.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后地板很滑。
words.en: Something that is slippery is smooth, wet, or oily and is therefore difficult to walk on or to hold.

words.ex: The procession moved slowly down the street.
words.ex_cn: 行列缓缓沿着街道行进。
words.en: A procession is a group of people who are walking, riding, or driving in a line as part of a public event.

words.ex: The apples ripen in autumn.
words.ex_cn: 苹果在秋天成熟。
words.en: When crops ripen or when the sun ripens them, they become ripe and ready to eat.

words.ex: He is jealous of his brother's new bike.
words.ex_cn: 他嫉妒他弟弟的新自行车。
words.en: If someone is jealous, they feel angry or bitter because they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.ex: He felt jealousy when his friend got a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 当他的朋友得到一辆新自行车时，他感到妒忌。
words.en: Jealousy is the feeling of anger or bitterness which someone has when they think that another person is trying to take a lover or friend, or a possession, away from them.

words.ex: He is a liar because he told a lie.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个骗子，因为他撒了谎。
words.en: A liar is someone who tells lies.

words.ex: He went to his high school homecoming last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 他上周末去了他的高中返校节。
words.en: Homecoming is the act of returning to your home after being away for a long time, or a celebration at a school or college, usually once a year, for former students.

words.ex: The barber cuts hair every day.
words.ex_cn: 理发师每天剪头发。
words.en: A barber is a person whose job is cutting men's hair and sometimes shaving their beards.

words.ex: She tried to whiten her teeth with a special toothpaste.
words.ex_cn: 她尝试用一种特殊的牙膏使牙齿变白。
words.en: To make or become white or whiter.

words.ex: He picked a red berry from the bush.
words.ex_cn: 他从灌木丛中摘了一颗红色浆果。
words.en: A berry is a small, round fruit that grows on a bush or a tree. Some berries are edible and can be eaten raw or used in cooking.

words.ex: Music can lighten your stress.
words.ex_cn: 音乐可以减轻你的压力。
words.en: To make or become lighter or less dark; to make or become less heavy or serious.

words.ex: The pigeon sits on the window sill.
words.ex_cn: 鸽子坐在窗台上。
words.en: A pigeon is a bird, usually grey in color, that is often seen in towns and is sometimes used for carrying messages.

words.ex: Rain can hinder our plan to go hiking.
words.ex_cn: 雨天会妨碍我们去徒步旅行的计划。
words.en: If something hinders you, it makes it more difficult for you to do something or make progress.

words.ex: His bravery saved the children from the fire.
words.ex_cn: 他的勇敢救了孩子们于火海之中。
words.en: Bravery is the quality of being brave; courage.

words.ex: He carried his baggage to the airport.
words.ex_cn: 他把行李带到了机场。
words.en: Baggage refers to the suitcases and bags that you take with you when you travel, or it can refer to emotional issues that someone carries with them from past experiences.

words.ex: Noun is a word for a person, place, or thing.
words.ex_cn: 名词是表示人、地方或事物的词。
words.en: A noun is a word that refers to a person, place, thing, event, substance, or quality.

words.ex: He was amongst the first to arrive.
words.ex_cn: 他是最早到达的人之一。
words.en: If something is among other things, it is one of them.

words.ex: He is learning English grammar every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天都在学习英语语法。
words.en: Grammar is the system and structure of a language. The rules of grammar help us decide the order we put words in and which form of a word to use.

words.ex: The farmer's cultivation of rice takes months.
words.ex_cn: 农民种植水稻需要几个月的时间。
words.en: The process of trying to acquire or develop a quality or skill.

words.ex: His dog gave him constant companionship.
words.ex_cn: 他的狗给了他不断的陪伴。
words.en: the state of being with someone or having someone to spend time with

words.ex: He threw the rubbish into the bin.
words.ex_cn: 他把垃圾扔进了垃圾桶。
words.en: Waste material; refuse or litter.

words.ex: His modesty made everyone like him.
words.ex_cn: 他的谦虚让所有人都喜欢他。
words.en: Modesty is the quality of not being too proud or confident about yourself or your abilities.

words.ex: She wore a woolen scarf in winter.
words.ex_cn: 她在冬天戴了一条羊毛围巾。
words.en: Made of wool; relating to wool.

words.ex: The rain deepened the puddles on the road.
words.ex_cn: 雨水加深了路上的水坑。
words.en: If a situation or emotion deepens or if something deepens it, it becomes stronger and more intense.

words.ex: He bought a warm pastry from the bakery.
words.ex_cn: 他从面包店买了一个热乎乎的点心。
words.en: Pastry is a food made from flour, fat, and water that is mixed together, rolled flat, and baked in an oven. It is used as a base or covering for pies, tarts, and other dishes.

words.ex: She put the plates in the cupboard.
words.ex_cn: 她把盘子放在碗橱里。
words.en: A cupboard is a piece of furniture with doors and shelves that is used for storing things, usually in a kitchen.

words.ex: He bought a quart of milk at the store.
words.ex_cn: 他在商店买了一夸脱牛奶。
words.en: A quart is a unit of measurement for liquids, equal to two pints or approximately 1.14 liters.

words.ex: The boat travels through the canal.
words.ex_cn: 船通过运河航行。
words.en: A canal is a long, narrow stretch of water that has been made for boats to travel along or to bring water to a particular area.

words.ex: He writes his homework in a notebook.
words.ex_cn: 他把作业写在笔记本里。
words.en: A notebook is a small book for writing notes in, or a small computer that is easy to carry.

words.ex: His deceit made his friends lose trust in him.
words.ex_cn: 他的欺骗让朋友们失去了对他的信任。
words.en: Deceit is behaviour that is intended to make someone believe something that is not true.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.ex: The sun brightens the room in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早上使房间变亮。
words.en: To make something lighter or more colorful, or to make someone feel happier or more hopeful.

words.ex: He eats sweets with moderation.
words.ex_cn: 他吃甜食很适度。
words.en: Moderation is the quality of doing something within reasonable limits; not too much or too little.

words.ex: He is always punctual for class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课总是准时。
words.en: If you are punctual, you do something or arrive somewhere at the right time and are not late.

words.tr:
int. （表示高兴、赞成的欢呼声）好啊，万岁
n. 欢呼声
v. 欢呼；叫好
words.ex: Hurrah! We won the game!
words.ex_cn: 万岁！我们赢了比赛！
words.en: An exclamation of joy, approval, or encouragement.

words.ex: She put on red lipstick before the party.
words.ex_cn: 她在派对前涂了红色口红。
words.en: Lipstick is a colored substance in the form of a stick, used for coloring the lips.

words.tr:
adj. 最高地位、位置或职位的
adv. 最高地位、位置或职位地
words.ex: His safety is the uppermost concern.
words.ex_cn: 他的安全是最重要的关切。
words.en: The uppermost part or surface of something is the part or surface that is highest or nearest the top.

words.ex: The farmer feeds the pigs to fatten them.
words.ex_cn: 农夫喂猪使它们长胖。
words.en: To make or become fat or fatter.

words.ex: The conqueror took control of the small village.
words.ex_cn: 征服者控制了这个小村庄。
words.en: A conqueror is someone who conquers a country or group of people.

words.ex: The rain was a hindrance to the game.
words.ex_cn: 雨水对比赛造成了妨碍。
words.en: A hindrance is a person or thing that makes it difficult for you to do something.

words.ex: He showed cowardice when he ran away from the fight.
words.ex_cn: 他在打架时逃跑，表现出了懦弱。
words.en: Cowardice is the lack of courage to face danger, difficulty, opposition, or pain.

words.ex: The obedient child cleaned his room without being told.
words.ex_cn: 这个听话的孩子没被要求就打扫了房间。
words.en: An obedient person or animal does what they are told to do.

words.ex: He put the cup on a saucer.
words.ex_cn: 他把杯子放在一个茶托上。
words.en: A small shallow dish, typically circular, on which a cup is placed.

words.tr: v. 使发狂；使发疯；使发怒
words.ex: The loud noise madden him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的噪音让他发狂。
words.en: To make someone extremely angry or annoyed.

words.ex: My mom scolded me for coming home late.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈因为我回家晚而责备了我。
words.en: If you scold someone, you speak angrily to them because they have done something wrong.

words.tr: n. 工作日（周一至周五中的任何一天）
words.ex: He goes to work every weekday.
words.ex_cn: 他每个工作日都去上班。
words.en: A weekday is any of the days from Monday to Friday, when most people go to work or school.

words.ex: The apple is rotten and smells bad.
words.ex_cn: 这个苹果腐烂了，闻起来很难闻。
words.en: Something that is rotten has decayed and cannot be used for its normal purpose.

words.tr:
n. 不尊敬；无礼；轻蔑
v. 不尊重
words.ex: He showed disrespect to his teacher.
words.ex_cn: 他对老师表现出不尊重。
words.en: If someone shows disrespect, they speak or behave in a way that shows lack of respect for someone or something.

words.ex: The widower lives alone with his cat.
words.ex_cn: 这位丧偶的男子独自和猫住在一起。
words.en: A man whose spouse has died and who has not remarried.

words.ex: The loud music deafened him.
words.ex_cn: 巨大的音乐让他耳聋了。
words.en: If a noise deafens you, it is so loud that you cannot hear anything else at the same time.

words.tr: adj. 有效率的；认真的；有条理的
words.ex: She gave a businesslike reply to the question.
words.ex_cn: 她对这个问题给出了一个高效的回答。
words.en: If you describe someone's approach as businesslike, you mean that they deal with things in an efficient way without wasting time.

words.tr: n. 母性; 母亲身份; 母亲们（总称）
words.ex: She loves motherhood and enjoys taking care of her baby.
words.ex_cn: 她热爱母职，享受照顾宝宝的过程。
words.en: Motherhood is the state of being a mother, or the qualities or feelings associated with being a mother.

words.ex: The news saddened her.
words.ex_cn: 这个消息让她感到悲伤。
words.en: If something saddens you, it makes you feel sad.

words.ex: They shook hands with a firm handshake.
words.ex_cn: 他们以坚定的握手示意友好。
words.en: A handshake is a gesture in which two people grasp one of each other's like hands, in most cases accompanied by a brief up and down movement of the grasped hands.

words.ex: He uses a calculator to add numbers.
words.ex_cn: 他用计算器来加数字。
words.en: A calculator is a small electronic device that you use for doing mathematical calculations.

words.tr: n. 头饰；头巾；头发编梳的式样
words.ex: She wore an elaborate headdress for the wedding.
words.ex_cn: 她为婚礼戴了一顶精致的饰头巾。
words.en: A headdress is a decorative covering or ornament worn on the head.

words.ex: She cut the paper with scissors.
words.ex_cn: 她用剪刀剪了纸。
words.en: Scissors are a tool used for cutting paper, cloth, hair, etc., consisting of two sharp blades fastened together in the middle so that the sharp edges slide against each other.

words.ex: The translator helped him understand the French book.
words.ex_cn: 这位翻译员帮他理解了这本法语书。
words.en: A translator is a person whose job is translating writing or speech from one language to another.

words.tr: n. 持有者；所有人；主人
words.ex: He is the possessor of the old key.
words.ex_cn: 他是那把旧钥匙的拥有者。
words.en: A possessor is someone who owns or has something.

words.tr: n. 先令（英国1971年以前的辅币，等于12便士）
words.ex: He paid five shillings for the bread.
words.ex_cn: 他花了五个先令买面包。
words.en: A shilling was a coin used in Britain before the decimalization of the currency in 1971, worth one twentieth of a pound or twelve pence.

words.ex: The sky began to redden as the sun set.
words.ex_cn: 太阳落山时，天空开始变红。
words.en: To make or become red; to blush.

words.ex: She gave him a motherly hug when he was sad.
words.ex_cn: 当他难过时，她给了他一个慈母般的拥抱。
words.en: Motherly is used to describe feelings or actions that are like those of a kind and caring mother.

words.ex: The boy whose bag is red is my brother.
words.ex_cn: 那个书包是红色的男孩是我弟弟。
words.en: You use whose to ask about the person that something belongs to or is associated with.

words.tr: n. 耕者；栽培者；耕田机
words.ex: The farmer uses a cultivator to prepare the soil.
words.ex_cn: 农民使用耕作机来准备土壤。
words.en: A cultivator is a person or machine that prepares land for growing crops.

words.ex: Whom did you invite to the party?
words.ex_cn: 你邀请了谁来参加派对？
words.en: You use whom in questions when you ask about the name or identity of a person or group of people.

words.ex: He finished his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭前完成了家庭作业。
words.en: Homework is school work that teachers give to pupils to do at home in the evening or at the weekend.

words.ex: The electrician fixed the broken light.
words.ex_cn: 电工修好了坏掉的灯。
words.en: An electrician is a person whose job is to install and repair electrical equipment.

words.ex: He rowed the boat with an oar.
words.ex_cn: 他用桨划船。
words.en: An oar is a long pole with a wide, flat blade at one end, used for rowing a boat.

words.ex: He went to jail for bribery.
words.ex_cn: 他因贿赂而入狱。
words.en: Bribery is the act of offering, giving, receiving, or soliciting something of value for the purpose of influencing the action of an official in the discharge of his or her public or legal duties.

words.ex: She added sugar to sweeten the tea.
words.ex_cn: 她加了糖来使茶变甜。
words.en: To make something sweet or sweeter, especially by adding sugar.

words.ex: He sows seeds in the garden every spring.
words.ex_cn: 他每年春天都在花园里播种。
words.en: To sow means to plant seeds in the ground so that they will grow into plants.

words.ex: His pronunciation of English words is very clear.
words.ex_cn: 他英语单词的发音非常清晰。
words.en: The way in which a word or a language is spoken.

words.ex: The bird uses its beak to eat seeds.
words.ex_cn: 这只鸟用它的喙吃种子。
words.en: The hard, pointed, often curved part of a bird's mouth, used for picking up and eating food.

words.tr: adj. 复数的； n. 复数；
words.ex: The word 'cats' is a plural form.
words.ex_cn: 单词 'cats' 是复数形式。
words.en: The plural form of a word is the form that is used when referring to more than one person or thing.
